contractPreserved.dedupe: read-before-write of the latest event's detail.signature; an unchanged signature skips the insert but still prunes
contractPreserved.readProjection: id, event_type, severity, source_key, summary, detail, created_at ordered created_at DESC limit N (default 20, max 100)

authority.readCanaryReason: a partial read is not a meaningful state
authority.canarySelector: the Node writer adds detail.m11AdminOpsEventsCanary=true only while the marker env is true/1; the boundary's d1-canary selector accepts only that exact boolean

boundary.writeAuth: GitHub OIDC JWT or constant-time OPS_WRITE_TOKEN bearer
boundary.readAuth: GitHub OIDC JWT or constant-time OPS_WRITE_TOKEN bearer
boundary.restingRelay: internal worldcons-search Service Binding (never the public internet)
boundary.d1FailureBehavior: fail closed (503); never silently downgraded to Supabase

d1Statements.insert: INSERT INTO admin_ops_events (id, event_type, severity, source_key, summary, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
d1Statements.latest: SELECT id, event_type, severity, source_key, summary, detail, created_at FROM admin_ops_events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
d1Statements.list: SELECT id, event_type, severity, source_key, summary, detail, created_at FROM admin_ops_events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?

failClosed.selectedD1WriteUnavailable: throws at the Node writer / 503 at the boundary
